'''Claris''' was a member of a [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] team sent to aid in the liberation of [[Verkuyl]]. She worked with the [[Verkuylian resistance]] to set explosives around Verkuyls main communications transmitter to cut off the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] from outside aid. The transmission she sent to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in waiting was captured by the Imperials resulting in her arrest. She survived the mission and was released after the fleet was contacted by [[Selby Jarrad]] and Verkuyl was liberated.
